liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Greeting/Tuning**: mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]
- **Greenville Trestle High**: back after 73 archived shows (500 days); rare: 4 archived performances [9]
- **Band Introdctions**: rare: 4 archived performances [9]
- **Thirst**: back after 297 archived shows (1988 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [9]
- **#Country Blues**: rare: 10 archived performances [9]
- **Happy Birthday 10 Year Old Keller**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [9]
- **Wreck Of The Edmund Fitzgerald**: rare: 3 archived performances [9]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2025-04-19** (recommended): source not stated; 24 songs; 158 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds very good [6]
- **bstr2025-04-19**: audience recording; 22 songs; 158 min [2]
- **billystrings2025-04-19.akgmtx**: source not stated; 22 songs; 159 min [3]
- **billystrings2025-04-19.AKGck3X**: source not stated; 22 songs; 159 min [4]

## Around the show

- K-Mac assisted the taper; this was show number 92 of 2025 for the taper, under Team Dirty South and Home Team Recording [1]
- Taped from the pit, center, back against the ADA barrier, roughly 50 meters from the stage [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2025-04-19**: taped by Z-Man; transferred by Z-Man; source: Schoeps CCM4V'S>Sound Devices Mix-Pre 6 II (48/32) [1]
- **bstr2025-04-19**: taped by Ultramega; transferred by Ultramega; source: AUD CA14 Cardioids->Tascam DR-07x 24bit/48k [2]. Also: Recorded with CA14 cardioid mics into a Tascam DR-07x at 24-bit/48k, then edited in Audacity and converted to FLAC [2]
- **billystrings2025-04-19.akgmtx**: taped by Marty Loving; transferred by Marty Loving; source: Source 1: AKG CK3X> Naiant PFA> Sound Devices MixPre-6 II @ 32/48 Source 2: AKG CK61> Naiant PFA> Sound Devices MixPre-6 II @ 32/48 [3]. Also: Recorded and uploaded by Marty Loving, who used clamp space provided by Z Man [3]
- **billystrings2025-04-19.AKGck3X**: taped by Marty Loving; transferred by Marty Loving; source: AKG CK3X> Naiant PFA> Sound Devices MixPre-6 II @ 32/48 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Musicdope90s: [Billy Strings Cary North Carolina Night 3 Koka Booth Amphitheatre On April 19 2025 Dragon Boats Racework Canvas - Musicd](https://musicdope90s.com/products/billy-strings-cary-north-carolina-night-3-koka-booth-amphitheatre-on-april-19-2025-dragon-boats-racework-canvas/) [10]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Koka Booth Amp 2025 - N2 Regular Poster - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/koka-booth-amp-2025-n2-regular-poster/) [11]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Koka Booth Amp 2025 - N3 Regular Poster - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/koka-booth-amp-2025-n3-regular-poster/) [12]
- Poster by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Koka Booth Amp 2025 - N1 Regular Poster - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/koka-booth-amp-2025-n1-regular-poster/) [13]
- Fan art by @BillybaseDotNet: [Billy Strings Koka Booth Amp 2025 - N2 Regular Poster - BillyBase](https://billybase.net/merch/koka-booth-amp-2025-n2-regular-poster/) [14]
- Poster by panetory.com: [Billy Strings Koka Booth Amphitheatre Cary NC Apr 19 2025 Concert Poster 2026](https://panetory.com/billy-strings-koka-booth-amphitheatre-cary-nc-apr-19-2025-concert-poster) [15]
